test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A sum of money becomes double in 5 years at compound interest rate. The same sum of money will be 4 times of itself in:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal(P) doubles itself in 5 years when compounded annually

**Formula used:**

Amount(A) = P[1 + (R/100)]T

Here, P = Sum, R = Rate of interest & T = time period

**Calculation: **

According to the question: 2P = P[1 + (R/100)]⁵

⇒ 2 = [1 + (R/100)]⁵

⇒ (2)¹/⁵ = 1 + (R/100) ----(i)

Let the required time period be T years

⇒ 4P = P[1 + (R/100)]T ----(ii)

From (i) and (ii), we get

4 = [(2)¹/⁵]T

⇒ 4⁵ = 2T

⇒ (2²)⁵ = 2T

⇒ 210 = 2T

⇒ T = 10

**∴ It will become 4 times in 10 years.**
